description.en: A mineralized mushroom fossil preserves a cap, stalk and gill traces.
description.zh: 矿化蘑菇化石保存菌盖、菌柄及菌褶痕。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Gondwanagaricites magnificus, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Gondwanagaricites magnificus 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Cap-and-stalk lamellate architecture differs from poroid fragments and bird's-nest cups.
distinctness.zh: 菌盖菌柄与菌褶结构区别于孔层残片及鸟巢状菌杯。

modeling_brief.en: Use the preserved side silhouette with a shallow exposed gill relief; no decorative spots or invented ring.
modeling_brief.zh: 采用保存的侧面轮廓和浅露菌褶浮雕，不加装饰斑点或臆造菌环。

uncertainty: Fruiting-body specimen, not a complete mycelium; original colour is unknown and nomenclature follows correction.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: The oldest fossil mushroom
sources.supports: Cretaceous mineralized gilled mushroom cap and stalk.
